name: Spectral TV
description: Build automatic Jellyfin Live TV channels and resumable on-demand smart channels from shows, seasons, episodes, and movies. Choose balanced, weighted, random, block, alternating, shuffle, fixed-sequence, or custom-pattern programming; keep each show's episode progress independent; insert optional promos and bumpers; use ordinary Jellyfin clients through native Live TV and private per-user playlists; optionally expose on-demand channels as a Channels row through Home Screen Sections; and connect the Spectral M3U/XMLTV sources to Jellyfin Live TV from an explicit one-click admin workflow.
overview: Virtual live and on-demand TV channels for Jellyfin

versions.changelog:
- Register enabled on-demand channels as a Home Screen Sections row named Channels, using each viewer's private smart playlist as the native Jellyfin card while keeping the channel name visible
- Keep Home Screen Sections optional and isolated so its absence or startup timing can never block Jellyfin or core Spectral TV playback
- Repair partial/legacy Spectral TV databases without destructive channel-table rewrites, and isolate schema families so one old migration cannot block automatic or on-demand channels
- Add a release-gating legacy-schema upgrade probe in addition to the clean Jellyfin 12 Linux smoke test
- Make Channel Studio backend failures identify the failing method, route, and HTTP status instead of every problem appearing as a generic request error
- Simplify Channel Studio search results for dynamic channels, fixed sequences, and promo clips, and keep search results from covering the rest of the page
- Remove internal on-demand progress test controls from the normal interface while retaining non-destructive sequence preview
- Add Channel Studio for automatic Live TV and resumable on-demand smart channels
- Add one-click explicit registration of Spectral TV's M3U tuner and XMLTV guide with Jellyfin Live TV without touching unrelated tuner/provider entries
- Add balanced, weighted, and random live source selection while preserving independent sequential or random episode order
- Add alternating, block, balanced-random, weighted-random, random, shuffle-cycle, fixed-sequence, and custom-pattern on-demand programming
- Add separate promo, bumper, commercial, and station-ID pools that do not corrupt episode progress
- Materialize enabled on-demand channels as private per-user Jellyfin playlists so normal clients can play them without a custom client
- Track authenticated per-user progress and safely advance smart playlists only when Jellyfin playback belongs to the linked Spectral TV queue
- Preserve Jellyfin user visibility rules, resume positions, patched dependency auditing, Linux/Synology package sanitization, and startup safety checks
